programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "The Cryosphere"
programme.desc: New satellites are being launched to continue detailed observations of Earth and its oceans an ice caps, They are finding that climate change is accelerating and they have the data to prove it.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Set Course for the Heart of the Sun"
programme.sub-title: Set Course for the Heart of the Sun
programme.desc: NASA’S Parker Solar Probe Mission is on its way and will be followed by Europe’s Solar probe Mission. No spacecraft have traveled so fast or so close to a star before. It is hoped to reveal the source of the solar winds that effect us on Earth.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Tickets, Please"
programme.desc: The commercial space flight companies are edging closer and closer to flight readiness. SpaceX and its Manned Dragon capsule in direct competition with Boeings moves closer to an ISS taxi service.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Mercury or Bust"
programme.desc: The ESA - JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Money Trouble"
programme.desc: Larry gets the offer of a lifetime: a Soviet era space suit. Torie pays big for an Apollo 11 artefact but it’s not what it seems. Cole meets Apollo 7 legend Walt Cunningham.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "The Apollo Sale"
programme.desc: Torie’s son Jason joins her on the road. Larry turns ‘gastronaut’ when he comes across some space food; and a collector’s flash sale sees Cole bid for an Apollo 11 item with an incredible story.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Good Luck, Bad Luck"
programme.desc: Cole gets lucky when he finds a Russian space suit in an old box, but the gloves are missing. To find the gloves he has to strike a deal with Larry. Torie hears how Coke and Pepsi joined the space race and meets former NASA astronaut Winston Scott.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Risk Taking, Money Making"
programme.desc: Torie and Larry duke it out on the auction floor for an incredible artefact. Cole meets astronaut Scott Parazynski who risked his life on one of the most daring spacewalks ever.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Endangered Aliens: Will Humans Trash Space?"
programme.sub-title: Endangered Aliens: Will Humans Trash Space?
programme.desc: Sci-Fi has always shocked audiences with images of powerful aliens invading and destroying Earth. What if WE are actually the invasive alien species?

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Record Day - Part 2"
programme.desc: The Flying Kestrel takes on the final records attempts, and the shocking results leave everyone reeling.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Crash"
programme.desc: After driver Jon Webster crashes the Flying Kestrel at 148 mph, the team must work out what went wrong and have to decide if the dream of a land speed record is worth risking it all?

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Rebuild"
programme.desc: The Flying Kestrel team regroup at Jon’s workshop as he shows them his new groundbreaking ideas to rebuild the car to give them the best chance at breaking a land speed record.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Test"
programme.desc: The new version of the Flying Kestrel is ready to be put to the test at one of the most state of the art wind tunnels. Has the team done enough to create a record-breaking car?

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Alois Bauer"
programme.desc: Alois Bauer grew up in Schwaz, in Tirol, Austria. His goal is building revolutionary, sophisticated, ecological and purposeful vehicles for work and recreation.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Tuncay Cakmak"
programme.desc: Physicist and Gamer Tuncay Cakmak came up with a way to let your body make the moves while you are immersed in VR with The Virtualizer.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Damon Wood"
programme.desc: Damon Wood is an American fromknown for inventing the fastest electric skateboard in the world! It was clocked at 62 km per hour on flat surface!

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Alan Gibbs"
programme.desc: Alan Gibbs, founder of Gibbs Amphibians, based in Michigan, Nuneaton, UK, and Auckland, New Zealand pioneers in high-speed amphibious vehicle technologies.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Life After Conflict"
programme.desc: We explore the environmental consequences of war and how different people, from Rohingya refugees to Syrian scientists, are trying to restore a healthy relationship with nature.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Feeding The Billions"
programme.desc: We explore potential new strategies to satisfy the growing food demand, from restaurants growing potatoes in the air to jellyfish as a potential sustainable meat alternative.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "The People's Voice"
programme.desc: We meet grassroots movements in US and UK who are fighting for a political intervention to stop climate change.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Plastic Into Products"
programme.desc: We meet enviro-entrepreneurs who recycle plastic waste to produce a large variety of items from fishing boats to coffee cups.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Living Virtually"
programme.desc: How did the invention of photography lead us to a world where we live entirely virtually? Alie Ward will point us towards a future where we might upload ourselves to the web.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Fighting Mortality"
programme.desc: What is the secret to eternal life? Alie Ward goes from an ancient herbal remedy to arrive at embryonic stem cells and the tantalising prospect of a future where we could be forever young.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Hacking Happiness"
programme.desc: What could possibly link rockets and antidepressants? Are we on the cusp of having a neural switch that can control our moods? Alie Ward weaves a chain of extraordinary connections.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Faking Faces"
programme.desc: Alie Ward falls through the wormholes of history into the Louisiana swamps, then journeys on to discover how poker-faced mischief and a mathematical code for winning games have brought us to machines that can invent very real faces.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "The Next Great Extinction Event"
programme.desc: Experts explain our history and evolution of Earth over its 4 billion year history and take us through to the current emergency where humans may be one of the species to become extinct.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "A.I. The Code For Consiousness?"
programme.desc: Hollywood has made us rather fearful of Artificial Intelligence, or A.I. But as we shall see, A.I. and its dance partner robotics might not be the nemesis we should fear; at least, not if we get them right.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "Germ Warefare"
programme.desc: A new enemy is emerging. This new enemy is the natural world itself, a microscopic realm of bacteria. And not just any bacteria, but the so-called super-bugs. We'll look at the emerging threats and what scientists are doing to counter them.

programme.title: Unearth S1 - "Nuclear 2.0"
programme.desc: To mitigate this climate emergency, we must use all of the tools at our disposal, like the Nuclear Energy. This documentary looks at the new safer nuclear technology and how it could be utilised in a coal burning country like Australia.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "Can You Power A Lawnmower With Grass?"
programme.sub-title: Can You Power A Lawnmower With Grass?
programme.desc: Andy from the Youtube channel 'How To Make Everything' tests if he can use clippings from mowing his lawn to create fuel that powers the very lawnmower he uses to do so.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "Cardboard Lumber Part 1"
programme.desc: In our new series with Andy from @How To Make Everything, we're exploring if household recyclabes can be turned into a lumber substitute.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "Cardboard Lumber Part 2"
programme.desc: In our new series with Andy from @How To Make Everything, we're exploring how to mass-produce building materials from household recyclabes.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "K-Cups/Recycled Plastic Into Shows"
programme.desc: K-Cups have made our morning routine wonderfully easier, bue we know that they create a lot of excess waste.

programme.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "Conceiving Consciousness"
programme.desc: Simone Giertz, Reggie Watts, & Naomi Fitter, join Dianna for an exploration of what consciousness is & whether it can ever be understood. Also, a robot tells jokes.

programme.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "Randomness & Probability"
programme.desc: Comedian Maz Jobrani & Blackjack legend Mike Aponte play the odds, meanwhile, Dianna finds order in chaos, and just maybe hacks the stock market.

programme.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "Truth & Logical Paradox"
programme.desc: Dianna dives through the looking glass in this paradoxical exploration of truth itself, where the left could be right, & right might be wrong. w/ guest Zach Pincince.

programme.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "The Infinite"
programme.desc: Kyle Hill & Eugenia Cheng join the show to prove there is more than one infinity, that infinity is hidden all around us, & that we might actually be infinite ourselves.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Death by Viper"
programme.desc: Back-to-back cold winters have been keeping Florida’s Burmese python population in check so the hunters head to Costa Rica to tangle with the region’s deadliest venomous snakes and soon find themselves on an American crocodile rescue mission.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Amazon Anaconda"
programme.desc: Putting everything on the line, the hunters head to Peru where they go off-road and off the map in search of the mighty green anaconda. Shawn has spent more than a decade exploring the jungles of Peru, buying land, and building a home away from home.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Stalking the Anaconda"
programme.desc: After tracking down the green anaconda in Peru’s Amazon basin, the hunters are determined to find another rare prize – the legendary black caiman. These elusive predators can grow up to 18 feet long, and their jungle habitat is too dangerous.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Rattlesnake Roundup"
programme.desc: Back in Florida, Burmese python numbers are way down. But that doesn’t mean the hunters are out of business. They take the pulse of a native biter, dance with a cobra, and then their mission goes nuclear to check on the health of Florida’s crocodile.
